bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
m=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM announcement_posts WHERE request_key LIKE 'room-announcement:%' AND updated_at >= '2026-11-11 14:45:00+00' AND updated_at < '2026-11-11 15:25:00+00'") || exit 70
test "$m" -gt 0 || exit 80
n=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE a.request_key LIKE 'room-announcement:%' AND a.updated_at >= '2026-11-11 14:45:00+00' AND a.updated_at < '2026-11-11 15:25:00+00' AND d.status='needs_reconcile'") || exit 71
test "$n" = 0 || exit 81
v=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE a.request_key LIKE 'room-announcement:%' AND a.updated_at >= '2026-11-11 14:45:00+00' AND a.updated_at < '2026-11-11 15:25:00+00' AND d.status='sending'") || exit 72
test "$v" = 0 || exit 82
sent=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE a.request_key LIKE 'room-announcement:%' AND a.updated_at >= '2026-11-11 14:45:00+00' AND a.updated_at < '2026-11-11 15:25:00+00' AND d.status='sent'") || exit 73
test "$sent" -gt 0 || exit 83
test "$sent" -gt 1 || exit 84
echo ROOM_TIMEWINDOW_HAS_NO_UNCERTAIN_DELIVERY
